text: Two tasks trained jointly: Masked Burst Modelling (cross-entropy over masked tokens) and Same Origin-Direction-Flow, a 5-class burst-pair classification (cross-entropy). Total loss = λ·loss_MBM + loss_SODF with λ = 0.1.

BYOL self-supervised learning on TCP-aware augmented flow variants (packet-length sequences): normalised mean-squared error between the online prediction and the target projection, symmetrised over the two variants; target network updated as a moving average with decay 0.996.
